text:
emma_sales: Novaforge sent RFP asking for a 6-month POC. Key asks: EU data residency, BYOK/HSM, 200 req/sec steady with 400 req/sec burst, embedding quota 5M units, and a filled capability matrix. They attached a 40-question security appendix. Need us to send back a capability matrix + security answers + a POC pricing estimate by EOD tomorrow. Any immediate blockers? :eyes:

sam_se: I can own the POC scoping. For 200 rps we probably need Dedicated small pool. Will confirm exact GPU count with perf numbers.

ashley_se: Quick perf note: redwood-large-v1 @512 tokens -> ~60 req/s per A100-equivalent GPU under our batching profile. So 200 rps steady => ~4 GPUs, add autoscale to 6 for 400 burst. I'll attach perf_csv.

liam_product: For embeddings-heavy workload, recommend int4 quant + prefix KV cache for conversational flows to reduce cost. Expect ~40-50% token cost reduction vs fp16 for embeddings pipeline.

anya_security: I'll take the security questionnaire. We have SOC2 attestation + BYOK / HSM docs. Need to verify exact KMS flow Novaforge requires (customer-managed vs provider KMS). Also check if they asked FedRAMP-specific controls.

maria_sales_ops: Pricing back-of-envelope for 6mo POC: reserved baseline + overage + support. Ballpark $48k - $62k depending on committed GPUs and quantization. Need estimated token/hr to tighten.

ashley_se: Attaching: perf_novaforge_2026.csv (perf numbers) and a quick rollout snippet for fallback routing.

deploybot: Ticket created NF-4321. Files uploaded: novaforge_rfp_questions.pdf, capmatrix_template.csv, perf_novaforge_2026.csv

emma_sales: Two asks to close today: (1) Security: one-page attestation (SOC2 + encryption at rest/in-transit + BYOK note). (2) Engineering/ops: confirm canary fallback policy to a smaller model if capacity constrained and include the runtime config snippet.

anya_security: Yes, I can produce the attestation draft in ~45m. Will include KMS/HSM summary and where to find SOC2 report.

ashley_se: Canary/fallback supported. Example runtime policy:
```
{
  "route": "redwood-large-v1",
  "fallback": "redwood-medium-v1",
  "latency_threshold_ms": 300,
  "scale_policy": "autoscale"
}
```
I'll also note expected degradation in quality for the fallback model.

sam_se: Lead time question from Novaforge: can we stand up Dedicated pool in 2 weeks? Ops?

maria_sales_ops: Typical lead time: 10 business days if Dedicated capacity available, otherwise we can start POC using shared hosted pool + burst within 48-72 hours. If they need dedicated tenancy, plan 10 bd.

emma_sales: Perfect. I'll compile the filled capability matrix and a short cover email. @anya_security @ashley_se please drop your docs into the ticket NF-4321 folder so I can attach. Thanks all :heart:

ashley_se: Placing perf CSV + fallback snippet in the ticket now.

anya_security: Uploading attestation draft to NF-4321 in ~40m.

maria_sales_ops: I'll draft the pricing sheet and send to you for sign-off before EOD.

emma_sales: Great — wrapping up. I'll send the initial response to Novaforge by 9am tomorrow. If anything time-sensitive, DM me. :rocket:
